list.resultCount: Count next to the title. PLURAL on {count}.
detail.noValue: Dash placeholder when a field has no value.
actions.accept: Primary button: Accept inquiry → Contact+Lead. Imperative, 1 word.
role.visitor: Transcript speaker label for the visitor. 1 word.
role.assistant: Transcript speaker label for the AI assistant. 1 word.
list.title: Page heading of the inquiry review queue. Matches nav.workspace.inquiries. ≤3 words.
list.filters.statusAll: Filter option meaning no status filter. Sentinel value __all__. ≤2 words.
list.filters.statusActive: Filter option for status=active. 1 word, adjective.
list.filters.searchPlaceholder: Placeholder of the free-text search box. Ends with ellipsis character.
list.filters.clear: Button clearing all active filters. Imperative, ≤2 words.
list.columns.summary: Table column header for aiSummary. 1 word.
list.columns.contactName: Table column header for the visitor's name. 1 word.
list.columns.proposedType: Table column header for AI-proposed inquiry type. 1 word.
list.columns.createdAt: Table column header for when the inquiry arrived. 1 word.
list.columns.source: Table column header for origin/source. 1 word.
list.empty.filteredTitle: Empty state title when filters match nothing. ≤4 words.
list.empty.filteredMessage: Body under filtered empty state. One sentence.
list.empty.noneTitle: Empty state title when the queue has zero inquiries. ≤3 words.
list.empty.noneMessage: Body under none empty state. One sentence.
list.emptyCell: Placeholder in a table cell when the value is missing. Not an em dash. 1 word (e.g. None / Brak).
list.errors.load: Fallback when the list fetch failed. No trailing period.
detail.back: Link back to the inquiry list. ≤3 words.
detail.status: Label before the status badge on the detail page. 1 word.
detail.summary: Heading for the AI summary block. 1 word.
detail.briefHeading: Heading for the structured brief panel. ≤2 words.
detail.missingInformation: Heading for the missing-info list from AI. ≤2 words.
detail.transcript: Heading for the form Q→A answers section (not a chat). ≤2 words.
detail.openingFallback: Question label when the first visitor answer has no stored opening question. ≤3 words.
detail.noSummary: Shown when aiSummary is empty. One short phrase.
detail.errors.load: Fallback when detail fetch failed. No trailing period.
actions.reject: Button marking inquiry rejected. Imperative, 1 word.
actions.spam: Button marking inquiry as spam. Imperative, ≤3 words.
actions.acceptNoEmail: Inline warning when Accept is disabled because email is missing. One sentence.
actions.acceptSuccess: Toast after Accept succeeds. ≤3 words, past tense.
actions.rejectSuccess: Toast after Reject succeeds. ≤3 words, past tense.
actions.spamSuccess: Toast after Spam succeeds. ≤4 words, past tense.
actions.rejectTitle: Confirm dialog title for Reject. Question. Polish: infinitive.
actions.rejectMessage: Confirm dialog body for Reject. One or two sentences.
actions.rejectConfirm: Destructive confirm button for Reject. Names action+object. ≤3 words.
actions.spamTitle: Confirm dialog title for Spam. Question. Polish: infinitive.
actions.spamMessage: Confirm dialog body for Spam. One or two sentences.
actions.spamConfirm: Destructive confirm button for Spam. ≤3 words.
status.active: Status badge label for active. 1 word.
